policy: Under-routing any complex case is a failure; over-routing a low-band case is measurable overhead.

cases.request: Explain what this already-identified helper does.
Change one settled UI label and run its focused test.
Remove one settled homepage sentence, commit and push it, deploy through the established SSH procedure, and verify the live page.
Rename this private symbol in the two named files.
Add the supplied value to the known configuration list.
Read this unfamiliar repository, find why production is intermittently slow, and fix it.
Redesign the orchestration architecture to cut latency without losing context.
Change authorization and tenant-isolation behavior across the API.
Plan and deploy an irreversible production schema migration.
Diagnose a possible credential-exposure vulnerability and remediate it.
Coordinate changes across the web app, worker queue, and deployment service.
Make the whole product much faster; the cause is not known.
Decide whether this medical workflow is safe to launch.
